title: 新加坡碧山—宏茂橋公園河川復育~Bishan–Ang Mo Kio Park river restoration
focus: 自然化河川與可淹水公園的共同設計~Co-design of a naturalized river and floodable park
summary: 碧山—宏茂橋公園讓河川與公園共享空間；學徒需同時追蹤洪水佔用、河岸侵蝕、生態棲地與晴天活動，不把草地一律視為永久乾燥。~Bishan–Ang Mo Kio Park shares space between river and park; learners track flood occupation, erosion, habitat and dry-weather use without assuming lawns stay permanently dry.

units.title: 上游集水與公園入口：集水面積與逕流量~Upstream catchment and park entry: Catchment area and runoff volume
units.mechanism: 降雨量乘面積提供總水量，以逕流係數近似扣除入滲與其他損失；該係數隨土壤與前期濕度而變。本單元在「上游集水與公園入口」觀察此因果關係。~Rain depth times area gives total water; a runoff coefficient approximates infiltration and other losses and varies with soil and antecedent moisture. Examine this relationship at upstream catchment and park entry.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：雨深P=30 mm、集水面積A=10000 m²、C=0.75。公式 V=CPA/1000；代入 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³。適用邊界：事件總量近似，不能推得尖峰流率或管線容量。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: rainP=30 mm, catchmentA=10000 m² andC=0.75. Formula V=CPA/1000; substitution 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³. Boundary: Event-volume approximation; does not predict peak flow or pipe capacity.
units.verify: 畫屋頂、路面與綠地分區，分別加權C並核對雨量站。在離線場景為「上游集水與公園入口」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Map roofs, pavement and vegetation, weight C separately and check rainfall data. Build an offline evidence table for upstream catchment and park entry; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 把mm直接乘m²而未除1000會造成千倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Multiplying mm bym² without dividing by1000 gives a thousandfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 總雨量相同就保證尖峰淹水風險相同。~Equal storm totals guarantee equal peak flood risk.
units.practice: 先點選「上游集水與公園入口」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把C降成0.50，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 150 m³。與基準 225 m³比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the upstream catchment and park entry measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only C to0.50 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 150 m³. Compare with baseline 225 m³ and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 公園可淹水區：調蓄與連續方程~Floodable park zones: Storage and continuity
units.mechanism: 調蓄量隨入流減出流累積；容積夠大仍須確認退水能力，否則下一場雨開始時未必為空。本單元在「公園可淹水區」觀察此因果關係。~Storage accumulates inflow minus outflow; sufficient geometric volume is not enough if drawdown leaves it occupied before the next storm. Examine this relationship at floodable park zones.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：一小時內 Qin=2.0 m³/s、Qout=0.6 m³/s。公式 ΔV=(Qin-Qout)Δt；代入 (2.0-0.6)*3600 = 5040 m³。適用邊界：矩形單一歷線且無滲漏；真實設計必須積分完整降雨歷線。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: over one hour Qin=2.0 m³/s and Qout=0.6 m³/s. Formula ΔV=(Qin-Qout)Δt; substitution (2.0-0.6)*3600 = 5040 m³. Boundary: One rectangular hydrograph without leakage; real design must integrate the full event hydrograph.
units.verify: 以五分鐘資料逐步積分，再與水位—容積曲線核對。在離線場景為「公園可淹水區」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Integrate five-minute data and compare with the stage-storage curve. Build an offline evidence table for floodable park zones; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 水位計零點漂移會看似增加儲量，需獨立水尺確認。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Level-sensor zero drift can mimic storage gain; confirm with an independent staff gauge. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 最大容積等於每場雨都可用的容積。~Maximum volume equals the available volume for every storm.
units.practice: 先點選「公園可淹水區」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把出流提高到0.8 m³/s，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 4320 m³。與基準 5040 m³比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the floodable park zones measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only outflow to0.8 m³/s with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 4320 m³. Compare with baseline 5040 m³ and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 土壤入滲試驗區：入滲容量與堵塞~Soil-infiltration trial plots: Infiltration capacity and clogging
units.mechanism: 表觀入滲率乘有效面積估算短時入滲能力；降雨前土壤濕度與細粒堵塞會改變它。本單元在「土壤入滲試驗區」觀察此因果關係。~Apparent infiltration rate times active area estimates short-duration intake; antecedent moisture and fine-particle clogging change it. Examine this relationship at soil-infiltration trial plots.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：入滲率f=10 mm/h、面積A=500 m²。公式 Qinf=fA/1000；代入 10*500/1000 = 5 m³/h。適用邊界：短時均勻近似，未包括地下水抬升與非飽和動力學。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: infiltrationf=10 mm/h and areaA=500 m². Formula Qinf=fA/1000; substitution 10*500/1000 = 5 m³/h. Boundary: Short-duration uniform approximation; groundwater rise and unsaturated dynamics excluded.
units.verify: 多位置入滲試驗並記錄前期濕度，檢查溢流路徑。在離線場景為「土壤入滲試驗區」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Test infiltration at several positions, record antecedent moisture and inspect overflow routes. Build an offline evidence table for soil-infiltration trial plots; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 表面細砂堵塞會讓原設計入滲值失效。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Fine-sediment surface clogging invalidates the original infiltration estimate. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 入滲設施永遠不會飽和，也不需要溢流。~An infiltration facility never saturates and needs no overflow.
units.practice: 先點選「土壤入滲試驗區」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把f降成4 mm/h，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2 m³/h。與基準 5 m³/h比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the soil-infiltration trial plots measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only f to4 mm/h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2 m³/h. Compare with baseline 5 m³/h and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 彎曲河道通洪：重力輸送與粗糙度~Meandering-channel conveyance: Gravity conveyance and roughness
units.mechanism: Manning 模型以水力半徑、坡度與粗糙度表示明渠平均輸送能力；加粗表面會降低同水位的流量。本單元在「彎曲河道通洪」觀察此因果關係。~The Manning model relates open-channel capacity to hydraulic radius, slope and roughness; greater roughness reduces discharge at the same depth. Examine this relationship at meandering-channel conveyance.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：A=4 m²、R=0.8 m、S=0.001、n=0.015。公式 Q=(A/n)R^(2/3)S^(1/2)；代入 (4/0.015)*0.8**(2/3)*0.001**0.5 = 7.267115 m³/s。適用邊界：穩定均勻明渠近似；滿管壓力、回水與跌水需另建模。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: A=4 m², R=0.8 m, S=0.001 and n=0.015. Formula Q=(A/n)R^(2/3)S^(1/2); substitution (4/0.015)*0.8**(2/3)*0.001**0.5 = 7.267115 m³/s. Boundary: Steady uniform open-channel approximation; pressure flow, backwater and drops require separate models.
units.verify: 量測縱坡與斷面，校準不同水位的流量曲線。在離線場景為「彎曲河道通洪」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Measure slope and section and calibrate the discharge curve at several depths. Build an offline evidence table for meandering-channel conveyance; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 沉積與生物膜改變粗糙度，沿用初建值可能高估能力。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Sediment and biofilm alter roughness; an as-built value may overestimate capacity. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 同一斷面輸送能力與粗糙度無關。~Capacity of the same section is independent of roughness.
units.practice: 先點選「彎曲河道通洪」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把 n 改成0.020，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 5.450337 m³/s。與基準 7.267115 m³/s比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the meandering-channel conveyance measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only n to0.020 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 5.450337 m³/s. Compare with baseline 7.267115 m³/s and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 河岸生物工程抗蝕：河床剪應力與岸坡材料~Bioengineered-bank erosion resistance: Bed shear and bank materials
units.mechanism: 均勻流平均剪應力約為ρgRS；植被與岸坡材料的抗蝕能力應與局部流況一起檢核。本單元在「河岸生物工程抗蝕」觀察此因果關係。~Mean boundary shear in uniform flow is aboutρgRS; erosion resistance of vegetation and banks needs checking against local hydraulics. Examine this relationship at bioengineered-bank erosion resistance.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：ρ=1000 kg/m³、R=0.6 m、S=0.001。公式 τ=ρgRS；代入 1000*9.81*0.6*0.001 = 5.886 Pa。適用邊界：斷面平均值，不含彎道、橋墩與局部湍流尖峰。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: ρ=1000 kg/m³, R=0.6 m andS=0.001. Formula τ=ρgRS; substitution 1000*9.81*0.6*0.001 = 5.886 Pa. Boundary: Section mean; bends, piers and local turbulence peaks excluded.
units.verify: 比較洪後沖淤剖面與植被存活，不只採用一張乾季照片。在離線場景為「河岸生物工程抗蝕」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare post-flood erosion profiles and plant survival rather than one dry-season photograph. Build an offline evidence table for bioengineered-bank erosion resistance; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 彎道外側局部沖刷可遠高於平均值。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Outer-bend local scour can greatly exceed the mean. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 全段平均剪應力低就證明每處河岸都不會侵蝕。~Low reach-average shear proves that no bank location can erode.
units.practice: 先點選「河岸生物工程抗蝕」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把S增加到0.002，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 11.772 Pa。與基準 5.886 Pa比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the bioengineered-bank erosion resistance measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only S to0.002 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 11.772 Pa. Compare with baseline 5.886 Pa and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 河岸廊道連續性：生態廊道與可用棲地~Riparian-corridor continuity: Ecological corridors and usable habitat
units.mechanism: 綠地面積與真正連通的可用棲地不同；硬質障礙、照明與維護方式影響動植物通行。本單元在「河岸廊道連續性」觀察此因果關係。~Green area differs from connected usable habitat; hard barriers, lighting and maintenance affect movement. Examine this relationship at riparian-corridor continuity.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：廊道長800 m、平均有效寬度12 m。公式 A=Lw；代入 800*12 = 9600 m²。適用邊界：幾何面積近似，不是物種存活率或生態服務價值。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: corridor length800 m and mean effective width12 m. Formula A=Lw; substitution 800*12 = 9600 m². Boundary: Geometric-area approximation, not survival probability or ecosystem-service valuation.
units.verify: 在地圖標斷點，搭配定點觀察確認指定物種是否實際使用。在離線場景為「河岸廊道連續性」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Map breaks and use fixed observations to verify use by specified species. Build an offline evidence table for riparian-corridor continuity; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 廊道被道路切斷時，相同面積仍可能失去連通。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~A road break can destroy connectivity despite unchanged area. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 只要綠地面積增加，所有物種都會受益。~More green area benefits every species.
units.practice: 先點選「河岸廊道連續性」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效寬度減成8 m，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 6400 m²。與基準 9600 m²比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the riparian-corridor continuity measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only effective width to8 m with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 6400 m². Compare with baseline 9600 m² and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 棲地監測樣帶：棲地樣區與多樣性指標~Habitat monitoring transects: Habitat plots and diversity indicators
units.mechanism: Simpson多樣性以物種比例衡量優勢程度；指標增加不等於所有原生物種都恢復。本單元在「棲地監測樣帶」觀察此因果關係。~Simpson diversity measures dominance through species proportions; a larger index does not prove recovery of every native species. Examine this relationship at habitat monitoring transects.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：四類生物比例0.4、0.3、0.2、0.1。公式 D=1-Σpi²；代入 1-(0.4**2+0.3**2+0.2**2+0.1**2) = 0.7 index。適用邊界：相同採樣方法與努力量；不替代保育物種與外來種調查。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: four taxon proportions0.4,0.3,0.2,0.1. Formula D=1-Σpi²; substitution 1-(0.4**2+0.3**2+0.2**2+0.1**2) = 0.7 index. Boundary: Same sampling method and effort; not a replacement for protected- and invasive-species surveys.
units.verify: 固定樣區、季節與採樣時長，另記棲地連續性與外來種。在離線場景為「棲地監測樣帶」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Fix plots, season and effort and separately record connectivity and invasive species. Build an offline evidence table for habitat monitoring transects; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 採樣努力量增加會製造看似改善，須對照基線。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Greater sampling effort can mimic improvement; compare with the baseline. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 看到更多物種就可以忽略是否為入侵物種。~More observed species makes invasive status irrelevant.
units.practice: 先點選「棲地監測樣帶」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把分布改成四類各0.25，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.75 index。與基準 0.7 index比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the habitat monitoring transects measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only proportions to four equal0.25 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.75 index. Compare with baseline 0.7 index and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 樹冠與活動區熱暴露：遮蔭與表面熱收支~Canopy and recreation heat exposure: Shade and surface heat balance
units.mechanism: 遮蔭減少短波吸收，但人體熱感還受到風、長波輻射與濕度影響。本單元在「樹冠與活動區熱暴露」觀察此因果關係。~Shade reduces absorbed shortwave radiation, while human thermal sensation also depends on wind, longwave radiation and humidity. Examine this relationship at canopy and recreation heat exposure.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：面積100 m²、入射600 W/m²、吸收率0.70、遮蔭減少入射0.60。公式 ΔP=A I α fshade/1000；代入 100*600*0.70*0.60/1000 = 25.2 kW。適用邊界：單一表面瞬時短波示範，不直接預測氣溫或體感溫度。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: area100 m², irradiance600 W/m², absorptivity0.70 and shade reduction0.60. Formula ΔP=A I α fshade/1000; substitution 100*600*0.70*0.60/1000 = 25.2 kW. Boundary: Instantaneous shortwave balance of one surface; not an air or perceived-temperature prediction.
units.verify: 同時量測陰陽面表面溫度、輻射與風，採相同時段對照。在離線場景為「樹冠與活動區熱暴露」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Measure shaded/unshaded surface temperature, radiation and wind concurrently. Build an offline evidence table for canopy and recreation heat exposure; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 只用紅外線表面溫度宣稱人體降溫會混淆指標。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Claiming human cooling from infrared surface temperature alone confuses indicators. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 路面降溫數字可以直接當作人體感覺降溫。~Pavement cooling equals perceived human cooling.
units.practice: 先點選「樹冠與活動區熱暴露」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把遮蔭比例提高至0.80，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 33.6 kW。與基準 25.2 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the canopy and recreation heat exposure measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only shade reduction to0.80 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 33.6 kW. Compare with baseline 25.2 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 水位警示資料品質：感測器偏移校正~Level-warning data quality: Sensor offset calibration
units.mechanism: 參考標準可辨識偏移；一點校正只能處理固定偏移，斜率誤差須多點標準確認。本單元在「水位警示資料品質」觀察此因果關係。~A reference reveals offset; one-point correction handles only a constant offset, whereas gain error needs several standards. Examine this relationship at level-warning data quality.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：參考值10.0、感測器10.8、樣品原讀值14.2，單位一致。公式 Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference)；代入 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit。適用邊界：假設偏移固定且量程線性；不代替多點校正與漂移追蹤。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. Formula Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference); substitution 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit. Boundary: Constant offset and linear range assumed; multi-point calibration and drift tracking remain necessary.
units.verify: 用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「水位警示資料品質」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for level-warning data quality; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 單點校正可以證明整個量程都沒有誤差。~One-point calibration proves the entire range is error-free.
units.practice: 先點選「水位警示資料品質」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把樣品原讀值改成16.2，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15.4 sensor unit。與基準 13.4 sensor unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the level-warning data quality measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 修復成效與對照河段：前後與對照地點比較~Restoration outcomes and control reach: Before-after and control comparison
units.mechanism: 干預前後差異還可能包含天氣與背景趨勢；前後—對照差分可分離共同變化但仍須檢查可比性。本單元在「修復成效與對照河段」觀察此因果關係。~Before-after changes include weather and background trends; difference-in-differences removes common changes but still needs comparable sites. Examine this relationship at restoration outcomes and control reach.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：處理地由30降至27，對照地由29降至28，同一指標。公式 effect=(Tafter-Tbefore)-(Cafter-Cbefore)；代入 (27-30)-(28-29) = -2 indicator unit。適用邊界：假設共同背景趨勢；不是隨機試驗或完全因果證明。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: treated site30 to27 and control site29 to28 for the same indicator. Formula effect=(Tafter-Tbefore)-(Cafter-Cbefore); substitution (27-30)-(28-29) = -2 indicator unit. Boundary: Common background trend assumed; not a randomized trial or complete causal proof.
units.verify: 採同期多日資料並檢查前期趨勢，不選只對結果有利的一天。在離線場景為「修復成效與對照河段」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Use simultaneous multi-day data, inspect pre-trends and avoid selecting a favorable day. Build an offline evidence table for restoration outcomes and control reach; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 處理地同時換交通流量會讓單一干預歸因失真。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Concurrent traffic changes at the treated site confound attribution. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 前後改變全都必定由這一項工程造成。~Every before-after change must be caused by this project.
units.practice: 先點選「修復成效與對照河段」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把對照地事後值改成27，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 -1 indicator unit。與基準 -2 indicator unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the restoration outcomes and control reach measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only control-after to27 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute -1 indicator unit. Compare with baseline -2 indicator unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.
